answer: Sybil resistance requires more than MRENCLAVE, which identifies enclave code but is not unique to a chip: each agent key must also be bound to hardware-backed instance evidence and checked against a one-registration policy. Remote attestation verifies the measurement and genuine platform; a pulse challenge, beacon record, and cedar audit trail can expose reuse. Without such controls, identical enclaves may run on multiple chips, but a VM alone cannot forge the attestation.
